leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Node.js project with Express framework for building a REST API
Configure Express middleware to handle JSON request bodies and route requests
Implement GET endpoints to retrieve all notes and specific notes by ID
Construct POST endpoints to create new notes with validation
Manipulate data by implementing PUT endpoints to update existing notes
Control data deletion by implementing DELETE endpoints to remove notes
Integrate error handling for invalid requests and missing resources
